title: TabPanel
description: A tabbed interface component with keyboard navigation, icons, counts, tooltips, and horizontal/vertical orientation.

icon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon displayed in the tab.

count.description: Badge count displayed on the tab.

tooltip.description: React.ReactNode — Tooltip content for the tab.

onValueChange.description: (tabId: string) => void — Callback fired when the active tab changes.

children.description: React.ReactNode | ((tab: Tab) => ReactNode) — Tab panel content, either static or a render function.

orientation.description: Layout orientation of the tab list.

activationMode.description: Whether tabs activate automatically on focus or require manual activation.

loop.description: Whether keyboard navigation loops from last tab to first.

iconPosition.description: Position of tab icons relative to the label.

showZeroCount.description: Whether to show a count badge when the count is zero.

alwaysShowLabels.description: Whether to always show tab labels (even when icons are present).

showTooltips.description: Whether to show tooltips on tabs.

tooltipOffset.description: Offset distance for tab tooltips in pixels.

disabled.description: Whether the entire tab panel is disabled.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.

renderTab.description: (props: TabRenderProps, defaultElement: React.ReactElement) => ReactNode — Custom tab render function.

aria-label.description: Accessible label for the tab list.

aria-labelledby.description: ID of the element that labels the tab list.

className.description: CSS class for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the root element.

forceMount.description: Force mount all tab panels regardless of active state.

keepMounted.description: Keep previously mounted tab panels in the DOM.
